versions.short: The bill would expand and update federal rules on sexual harassment, sexual assault, and equal employment at the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA), covering reporting, investigations, and victim privacy. It would require annual reports on these cases, including summaries of case outcomes and transfer requests, and would require the responsible entity of NOAA vessels to report certain incidents involving licensed mariners and vessel crew to the Coast Guard. It would also allow limited disclosure of a victim's identity in specified situations, require NOAA to create a confidential restricted reporting system within three years, and bar individuals convicted of certain sexual offenses from serving in NOAA's commissioned officer corps.
